name: shinchantw_cbt_d0_unpaid_d1_pay_stage_detail_20260730_164328_342001
sql:
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
D0NewUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND e."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND e."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
D0Payers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND e."$part_event" = 'charge'
      AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
),
D1FirstPay AS (
    SELECT
        e."#account_id" AS account_id,
        e."#event_time" AS first_d1_pay_time,
        dp."product_id@product_name_tc" AS first_d1_product_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e."#account_id" ORDER BY e."#event_time") AS pay_rank
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_13_0_20639 dp ON CAST(e.product_id AS INTEGER) = CAST(dp."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-30'
      AND e."$part_event" = 'charge'
      AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
),
TargetUsers AS (
    SELECT n.account_id, p.first_d1_pay_time, p.first_d1_product_name
    FROM D0NewUsers n
    LEFT JOIN D0Payers d0 ON n.account_id = d0.account_id
    INNER JOIN D1FirstPay p ON n.account_id = p.account_id AND p.pay_rank = 1
    WHERE d0.account_id IS NULL
),
D0Events AS (
    SELECT e."#account_id" AS account_id, e."#event_time" AS event_time
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    INNER JOIN TargetUsers t ON e."#account_id" = t.account_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
),
EventGaps AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        DATE_DIFF('second', CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP), LEAD(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time)) AS next_gap_seconds
    FROM D0Events
),
Duration AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN next_gap_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 119 THEN next_gap_seconds ELSE 0 END) / 60.0 AS d0_active_minutes
    FROM EventGaps
    GROUP BY 1
),
StageByUser AS (
    SELECT
        e."#account_id" AS account_id,
        COALESCE(TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT), TRY_CAST(e.stage_id AS BIGINT)) AS stage_id,
        COUNT(*) AS attempt_times,
        MAX(TRY_CAST(e.role_lev AS BIGINT)) AS max_role_level
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    INNER JOIN TargetUsers t ON e."#account_id" = t.account_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND e."#event_name" = 'stage_fight'
      AND CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = 1001
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
MaxStage AS (
    SELECT account_id, MAX(stage_id) AS max_stage_id
    FROM StageByUser
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    t.account_id AS "账户ID",
    ROUND(d.d0_active_minutes, 1) AS "D0活跃分钟",
    m.max_stage_id AS "D0最高主线关卡ID",
    ds."stage_id@stage_name_show" AS "D0最高主线关卡",
    s.attempt_times AS "最高关卡挑战次数",
    s.max_role_level AS "最高关卡角色等级",
    t.first_d1_pay_time AS "D1首笔充值时间",
    t.first_d1_product_name AS "D1首笔商品"
FROM TargetUsers t
LEFT JOIN Duration d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
LEFT JOIN MaxStage m ON t.account_id = m.account_id
LEFT JOIN StageByUser s ON m.account_id = s.account_id AND m.max_stage_id = s.stage_id
LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_18_0_52765 ds ON m.max_stage_id = ds."stage_id@stage_id"
ORDER BY "D0最高主线关卡ID", "账户ID"
